Welcome
Welcome to the Clark County Auditor’s Office!
Thank you for visiting our website, it is my pleasure to
introduce an updated platform to provide information in a more transparent and
easily accessible format. This site was
designed to provide you with information on the operations of the Auditor’s
Office. The goal of the Clark County
Auditor’s Office is to perform the statutory duties of the office and to
provide information and services as efficiently and accurately as possible.
It is our pleasure to serve the Citizens of Clark County and
users of data in a proficient and accountable manner. I am honored to serve as your Auditor!
Hillary
Hamilton
Clark County
Auditor

Tax Rates
Under law, the County Auditor cannot raise or lower property taxes. Tax rates are determined by the budgetary request of each governmental unit, as authorized by vote of the people, and are computed in strict accordance with procedures required by the State Department of Tax Equalization.
